decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line builds directly on the firm's core know-how in natural formulations and its supplier relationships, and its dedicated page in both years signals sustained commitment and readable market feedback that in-house development can use to refine it.

A hyaluronic acid serum is a mainstream, low-complexity extension of the firm's facial care knowledge and fits its integrated small-batch production, so it is likely retained, though its lower website prominence suggests a more marginal role.

The cleansing oil appears to replace the dropped cleansing milk and draws on the firm's oil-based natural formulation expertise, so management will give it time to gather results rather than drop it after only one year.
